answer: Each identity posts a 50-credit bond on the mesa registry and must finish three tasks across three epochs before its weight crosses the ledge. Auditors stamp a ferrous seal only on outputs matching the identity's key, so one worker's output cannot serve two identities. The k-th fake pays a fresh 50 credits plus three tasks, so 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 credits and need 3,000 tasks, without reuse. A rented task farm fails because toolchain fingerprints cluster its outputs, auditors void the cluster and burn its bonds. An honest agent posts one bond and does three tasks once.
